answer: In PoA, EigenTrust scores are computed from reciprocity-weighted endorsements and discounted by an exponential temporal half-life, so influence requires sustained honest service rather than a single favorable event. A freshly spawned Sybil identity begins near the nadir of eigenvector centrality, receives negligible trusted incoming mass, and cannot pass consensus through self-dealing or coordinated clones. Whether it provides nectar or timber is irrelevant until independent peers repeatedly verify its service.
